skill.description: The name of the step's skill folder (https://agentskills.io/specification); from the node id when absent

model.description: A model alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, inherit) or a model id; the session's model when absent

effort.description: The reasoning effort; the session's when absent

tools.description: The Claude Code tools the step's agent may use; the session's when absent

fresh.description: Runs the step as a reviewer: a fresh context that wrote none of the work, and only Read, Grep and Glob
